projects.title: LLM Model Testing and Evaluation
projects.description:
Conducted LLM model testing and evaluation by reviewing generated responses against defined evaluation criteria, identifying response quality issues across 100+ test prompts and documenting findings for model improvement.
Participated in brainstorming discussions with LLM models, analyzing response patterns, reasoning quality, and output consistency across 50+ evaluation scenarios to support model behavior analysis.
Developed and prepared training data for LLM model training, organizing 500+ example inputs and expected outputs to support training-data quality and model development workflows.

projects.title: Full Stack Application Development
projects.description:
Developed full-stack application functionality using Java, Spring Boot, React.js, TypeScript, and REST APIs, integrating frontend components with backend services across 10+ application workflows.
Implemented database operations using SQL, PostgreSQL, and MySQL, applying query optimization and data modeling to support application performance and maintainable data access.
